outcome: Association between maternal and fetal factors and intrauterine fetal death
finding: The incidence of intrauterine fetal deaths in the study population was higher than that reported from developed countries and was associated with anemia, pregnancy-induced hypertension, illiteracy, low socioeconomic status, and a higher incidence of undiagnosed congenital malformations.
mod_finding: 222 out of 250 deliveries resulting in intrauterine fetal death were unbooked and unsupervised.
